newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares leap 3.27 pct on fresh cash inflow.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares leap 3.27 pct on fresh cash inflow.

text.p: Istanbul shares jumped an average 3.27 percent with the help of fresh liquidity inflow on Tuesday morning despite persisting uncertainty over the fate of Turkey's Islamist-led coalition government, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 ended the session 48 points, or 3.27 percent higher at 1,518 after piercing the 1,500 resistance. Morning volume soared to 11.09 trillion lira from Monday's 6.51 trillion.
